description: This file defines the BrowseFragment class, an Android Fragment that provides a browsable UI for media content, connecting to a MediaBrowserService to list media items and handle user interactions within a media browsing app.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that connects to MediaBrowserService to display a list of media items and handle user interactions for media browsing.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes the adapter, sets up the ListView and its item click listener, and initializes the MediaBrowser connection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the MediaBrowser when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the MediaBrowser when the fragment stops.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BrowseFragment with the specified media ID.
